verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents a dedicated Skills API for uploading/managing skills and a Messages API `container` parameter (with `skill_id`, `type`, `version`, up to 20 skills per request) letting developers drive skills programmatically, alongside the open Agent Skills spec for portability. missing for 10: independent hands-on developer corroboration of the API (auth, rate limits, error handling) beyond first-party docs.
